chunks: These were the group of the praised, and we left mentioning their exhaustive enumeration because they are well-known and mentioned in the books.
ai.seo_question: Who are the praised companions of the Imams mentioned in Kitab al-Ghayba?
ai.summary: This passage highlights the 'group of the praised' (Jamāʿat al-Maḥmūdīn), a select circle of trusted deputies and narrators whose reliability is affirmed by the Imams. Tusi omits their exhaustive listing as they are already well-documented in established hadith collections, underscoring the continuity of the chain of transmission (isnād) and the scholarly consensus on their authority within Shia tradition.
